## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and result.

## Trust, safety, and security impact

Explain effects on input prohibitions, scoring, review authority, policy
controls, evidence, persistence, audit integrity, or external boundaries.
Write "none" only after checking.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests and branch coverage pass.
- [ ] Repository and reachable-history scans pass.
- [ ] The static mirror is current.
- [ ] Temporary source and wheel inspection passes.
- [ ] The real-browser public-site check passes.
- [ ] New safety-sensitive behavior has positive and benign-regression tests.
- [ ] Workflow actions are pinned to full commit identifiers when applicable.

## Provenance and data

- [ ] The contribution is original or has a documented compatible source.
- [ ] No confidential, personal, customer-specific, or production material is included.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are synthetic.
- [ ] License and notice material is updated if needed.

## Documentation

- [ ] User and operator documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] Changelog and readiness ledger are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Claims remain evidence-based.
